facts: Phase 3 gate 3 now requires deterministic pre-egress classification, redaction, and explicit allowlisting before any DeepSeek provider call.
Secrets, credentials, authorization headers, private financial/account data, raw sensitive chat content, and ambiguous or unclassified payloads are denied from provider egress.
DeepSeek remains advisory only and cannot own merge, release, credential, billing, production, core-goal, or risk-policy authority.
Provider output must be validated against repository evidence and deterministic tests/policy gates before affecting code, state, or decisions.
The policy change does not enable a provider call, credential use, billing change, production deployment, signing, live trading, or financial action.
decision: Keep PR #390 Draft and fail closed until exact-final-head CI, mergeability, review cleanliness, and the remaining Phase 3 gates are verified. Gate #232 remains the implementation authority for budget-safe and pre-egress-safe DeepSeek routing.
lesson: A bounded external AI worker requires an outbound-data trust boundary as well as spend limits; budget safety does not authorize data egress.
